This document loads the files and data needed to do the analysis performed in this project.

## Load Packages

This chunk loads the packages necessary to run the next chunk.

```{r}
#| label: packages01
# Packages used should be installed before loading

library("tidyverse")      # Used for the download function and mapping
library("readxl")         # Used to read the excel files
```

## Getting the Data

The data is placed in excel files from zenodo.org. Each file is loaded into the data/\_raw in order to use it later in this project. During loading the names of each file is also cleaned for better readability. All files are loaded even though only supplemental data set 1 is used in later analysis. This enables getting an overview of all the data available.

```{r}
#| label: getting-data
# Pulls the data from the online source into _raw/

## Creating directories if they don't exist
raw_dir <- "../data/_raw/"

if( !dir.exists("../data/") ){
  dir.create(path = "../data/")}

if( !dir.exists(raw_dir) ){
  dir.create(path = raw_dir)}

## Defining what files to be extracted from zenodo
files <- tibble(
  name = c("tpc119453_Supplemental Data Set 1.xlsx",
           "tpc119453_Supplemental Data Set 2.xlsx",
           "tpc119453_Supplemental Data Set 3.xlsx",
           "tpc119453_Supplemental Data Set 4.xlsx",
           "tpc119453_Supplemental Data Set 5.xlsx",
           "tpc119453_Supplemental Data Set 6.xlsx"),
  url  = str_c("https://zenodo.org/records/4936221/files/",
               URLencode(name), # converting string to comply with URL format
               "?download=1") # adding query string to request download 
)

## The function that downloads each file and clean the name (to not have spaces)
get_file <- function(name, url) {
  
  # Replace spaces in the file name with underscores
  clean_name <- str_replace_all(name, " ", "_")
  
  # Create destination path for the file
  dest <- str_c(raw_dir, clean_name)
  
  # Only run if file at destination doesn't exist
  if (!file.exists(dest)) {
    download.file(url, destfile = dest, mode = "wb")
  }
  dest
}

## Running the download
paths <- map2_chr(files$name, files$url, get_file)  #mapping that uses two arguments for a function (and makes it into a character)
```

Additional data was imported from NCBI GEO (Genome Expression Omnibus). This data was not accessible at zenodo.org and thereby needed to be downloaded on it's own.

```{r}
# Downloading the zipped textfile from ncbi
download.file(
  url = "https://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/series/GSE49nnn/GSE49289/suppl/GSE49289_Fujisawa_etal_NGS_FULRNAi_RPKM.txt.gz",
  destfile = "../data/_raw/GSE49289_Fujisawa_etal_NGS_FULRNAi_RPKM.txt.gz",
  mode = "wb"
)
```
